core: balanced, $25000 USD, default whole-share costs, zero positive-cash interest, no margin
composite: 0.5 * US value + 0.5 * US QMJ, native provider units; no volatility scaling
tails: core worst decile months and fixed 2008-09/2020/2022 windows; descriptive, not extra pass gates
decision: all criteria required to proceed to implementation feasibility; failure/inconclusive is not a universal rejection of long-only value/quality
limits: Heuristic research resource-allocation gate, not statistical proof or an expected Sharpe target.
No factor-cost or financing replication; do not add risk-free interest or subtract it again from long/short factors.
Individual value/quality diagnostics are recorded but cannot replace the frozen composite after inspection.
No blend, new region, weight search, paid data or paper trading in this stage.
